metadata.title: docs(howto): add RBAC and IBM Cloud how-to guides section
metadata.author: jonpspri

description:
## Summary

- Adds a new top-level **How-To Guides** documentation section (Diataxis-style task-oriented guides)
- Creates first guide: **Authorize Tools in a Virtual Server Using RBAC** — synthesized from `rbac.md`, `multitenancy.md`, `securing.md`, and `teams.md`
- Moves **IBM Cloud Code Engine** deployment guide into the howto section, enhanced with verification steps after each phase and a troubleshooting table
- Fixes 4 pre-existing issues in the IBM Cloud guide (grammar, JWT key length, typo, heading style)

### New files
- `docs/docs/howto/.pages` — nav for the howto section
- `docs/docs/howto/index.md` — landing page
- `docs/docs/howto/rbac-tool-authorization.md` — RBAC tool authorization how-to (257 lines)
- `docs/docs/howto/ibm-cloud-code-engine.md` — IBM Cloud deployment how-to (550 lines, moved + enhanced)
- `docs/plans/` — design and implementation plan docs

### Modified files
- `docs/docs/.pages` — added "How-To Guides" nav entry between Tutorials and Best Practices
- `docs/docs/deployment/ibm-code-engine.md` — replaced with redirect stub
- `docs/docs/deployment/index.md` — updated link to new location
- `docs/docs/index.md` — updated IBM Cloud link to new location

## Test plan
- [ ] Verify `mkdocs serve` renders the new How-To Guides tab with both guides
- [ ] Verify redirect stub in deployment section links correctly
- [ ] Verify all relative links in both guides resolve
- [ ] Verify tabbed content (API/CLI vs Admin UI) renders correctly in RBAC guide
- [ ] Verify admonitions render correctly in both guides

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body: This example uses `PATCH $GATEWAY_URL/admin/tools/$TOOL_ID` with a JSON body, but the codebase does not expose a PATCH JSON API at `/admin/tools/{id}` for updates (admin updates are via `/admin/tools/{id}/edit`), and the REST API update route is `PUT /tools/{tool_id}`. Please adjust the command to use an actual supported endpoint/method so the visibility change works.

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body:
This section references `gunicorn.conf.py`, but the repository’s Gunicorn config file is `gunicorn.config.py` (as also referenced elsewhere in this guide’s troubleshooting table). Please fix the filename here to avoid sending users to a non-existent file.
```suggestion
The container starts `gunicorn` with the settings defined in **`gunicorn.config.py`** found at the project root.
```

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body:
This plan document includes LLM-specific instructions ("For Claude" / "superpowers:executing-plans"). If these plan files are intended as durable repo documentation, consider removing or rewriting those lines to be tool-agnostic so they remain useful to all contributors.
```suggestion
> **Note:** Implement this plan task-by-task, following the steps in order.
```

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body: This PR is titled/described as a docs navigation + how-to addition, but it also makes substantial changes to the Makefile and adds new `.claude/skills/*` automation content. Please either update the PR description to explicitly call out these extra changes (and why they’re coupled), or split them into a separate PR to keep review scope clear.

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body:
The guide states tools default to `private`, but the public API schemas default `visibility` to `public` (and tool registration falls back to `public` when unset). Please update the wording so readers don’t assume newly created/registered tools are private by default.
```suggestion
Tools inherit their visibility from how they are registered. When registering tools
via the public APIs, `visibility` defaults to `public` if you do not set it explicitly.
A `private` tool is visible only to its owner and platform administrators with bypass
```

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body: Role assignment is shown as `POST $GATEWAY_URL/admin/users/<email>/roles`, but RBAC role assignment endpoints live under the `/rbac` router (e.g., `/rbac/users/{user_email}/roles`). Please update the path so the API/CLI instructions match the implemented RBAC API.

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body: These examples POST to `$GATEWAY_URL/tools/call` with `{name, arguments}`, but the gateway’s tool execution is not exposed as `/tools/call` in the REST API. Tool execution is performed either via JSON-RPC on `/rpc` with method `tools/call`, or via the server-scoped REST route `POST /servers/{server_id}/tools/{tool_name}/call`. Please update the examples to use a real execution endpoint and payload format.

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body: PR description mentions adding a DRAFT banner to this IBM Cloud Code Engine guide, but the published how-to file does not include any DRAFT admonition/banner at the top. Either add the banner as described or update the PR description to avoid misleading readers/reviewers.
